_comment: Orinoco AI Assistant Egg for Pterodactyl Panel 1.x. Import this file into a dedicated Nest. Preview only: do not deploy until the matching Orinoco image has been built and published.
name: Orinoco AI Assistant
author: Orinoco AI Project
description: Preview Egg for the self-hosted Orinoco assistant. Requires the Orinoco custom Docker image. Current application scaffold exposes a health endpoint only; assistant features are still under development.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/models
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/documents
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/backups
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data/logs

cat > /mnt/server/.orinoco-install-state <<'EOF'
Orinoco Pterodactyl server directory initialised.
Application code and runtime dependencies are supplied by the Docker image.
EOF

echo 'Orinoco server directories prepared.'

variables.name: AI Model
variables.description: Preferred local model. Model selection is planned; the current scaffold does not yet load models.

variables.name: Automatically Download Model
variables.description: Download the selected model when model management is implemented. This currently has no effect.

variables.name: Model Context
variables.description: Target context length in tokens. Planned setting; not yet applied by the scaffold.

variables.name: AI Concurrency
variables.description: Maximum simultaneous model requests. Initial intended value is one; not yet enforced.

variables.name: Enable Discord
variables.description: Discord integration is planned and currently unavailable.

variables.name: Discord Bot Token
variables.description: Reserved for the future Discord integration. Do not enter a real token until the integration and secret-handling guidance are implemented.

variables.name: Enable Voice
variables.description: Voice features are planned and currently unavailable.

variables.name: Enable Web Search
variables.description: Web research is planned and currently unavailable in the scaffold.

variables.name: SearXNG URL
variables.description: Optional future SearXNG endpoint. Leave blank until search integration is implemented.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used by Orinoco services when implemented.
